incident-bot: Pager: SEV2 detected — embeddings QPS spike on prod. Route: /v1/embeddings-hot. Aggregate QPS 3.4x baseline, tail latency >2s. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/embeds-surge. Pages: @oncall-sre @eng-ml.
Alex: On it, moving into #incidents. Taking ownership, tagging @jamie for mitigation. Collecting quick telemetry.
Jamie: I'm awake, joining now. What's the hot route and customer impact?
Alex: Per-route metrics: tenant-slice "research-app" = ~60% of spike. Route /v1/embeddings_hot qps=3500 (norm ~600). embed pool pool-emb-2 GPU util ~92%. Rerank downstream calls also increasing for same tenants. Chat routes nominal.
Kate-eng-ml: Likely a heavy batch generation or third-party job. Quick mitigations we can do: carve per-endpoint QPS for the hot tenant, enforce strict rate-limit headers on embed endpoints, and temporarily disable rerank for non-SLA tenants. Also increase prefix caching TTL for embeddings to reduce KV misses.
Alex: Plan: 1) Set per-endpoint QPS cap for research-app -> 800. 2) Disable rerank for non-enterprise tenants. 3) Apply traffic-shaper soft-shed on /v1/embeddings-hot to shed 60% of excess. 4) Bump embed prefix cache TTL to 10s. I'll apply steps now.
Jamie: Share commands so I can monitor and pick up if you need to handoff.
Alex: Commands I'm running:
```
/admin/quota set --tenant research-app --route /v1/embeddings --qps 800
/flags update --target rerank --state disabled --scope non-enterprise
/traffic-shaper apply --route /v1/embeddings-hot --policy soft-shed=0.6
/config set embeddings.kv_cache_ttl=10s
```
Alex: Running quota change...
ops-bot: audit log: quota-change queued by alex at 1970012388
Alex: Response: OK 200 — quota set qps=800 for research-app :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: audit log: quota-change committed by alex at 1970012390
Jamie: Observing immediate drop — research-app qps down to ~1200, overall embeddings qps down ~45%. Tail p95 latency improving from >2s to ~600ms. Errors trending down.
Kate-eng-ml: Nice. TTL bump applied?
Alex: Applying TTL now... done. Ops-bot: config-change applied embeddings.kv_cache_ttl=10s by alex at 1970012405
Jamie: Rerank disable applied for non-enterprise — feature flag updated. Metrics show rerank calls reduced ~70% for free-tier traffic.
Ryan-cs: Heads-up — two paying customers filed latency complaints. I'm notifying them: "We're applying temporary rate limits to protect platform stability; we'll follow up once stable and share ETA for resolution." Draft sent to CSMs.
Jamie: We'll hold mitigations steady for 10m and monitor. If stable, we'll re-enable rerank for enterprise-only and gradually relax QPS cap. If not, escalate to capacity add (spin up extra embed pool).
Alex: I'm stepping off in ~30m. Passing active ownership to Jamie for the next 2 hours. Leaving notes in PD and runbook.
Jamie: Taking handoff — I'll own the incident. Created incident ticket INC-2025-042, owner=jamie, start_ts=1970012345. Tagged @kate-eng-ml for follow-up on caching and root cause.
Alex: Thanks team — left logs and quick checklist in the runbook. :eyes:
Jamie: Will update customers after stabilization and open a postmortem thread in #postmortems. Great job on quick surgical carve, everyone. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-042 (SEV2) created, owner jamie, status: mitigated->monitoring.
